summary: Everest Group, Ltd. filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to report routine updates to financial statements and exhibits. The filing contains standard financial disclosures such as balance sheet, income statement, and comprehensive income data for the years ended December 31, 2023, 2024, and 2025, with segment breakdowns for insurance and reinsurance operations. It does not announce any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is a periodic update and lacks any special-situation event, with no deal terms or structural changes.
